title: Strengthening Long-Standing Partnerships| PLDT Enterprise | Royal Cable
summary: PLDT Enterprise and Royal Cablevision Corporation (Royal Cable) are strengthening their long-standing partnership
body_markdown:
**Makati City, Philippines, October 26** — PLDT Enterprise and Royal Cablevision Corporation (Royal Cable) are strengthening their long-standing partnership to support the cable television and broadband provider's continued growth, network expansion, and delivery of connectivity services to more communities and businesses across the Philippines.


Building on a relationship that began in 2010, the two companies recently renewed their partnership, enabling Royal Cable to leverage PLDT's extensive network infrastructure and last-mile connectivity capabilities to serve customers in areas where it has limited or no existing network presence.


The latest agreement reflects how the partnership has evolved over the years, from a traditional service provider relationship into a broader collaboration spanning connectivity, mobility, and data center solutions.


For Royal Cable, which began operations in Pampanga and has since expanded its services across multiple provinces, the partnership provides a foundation, and access to technologies that support its growing requirements without having to independently build every network asset needed for expansion.


"At PLDT Enterprise, we believe that a strong partnership goes beyond providing connectivity. It is about understanding where our customers want to grow and finding ways to help them get there. Our long-standing relationship with Royal Cable reflects this commitment, as we continue working together to support its expansion, strengthen its capabilities, and help bring quality digital services to more Filipinos," said Jay Lagdameo, Vice President and Head of Domestic Enterprise, Business, Regional and Commercial, PLDT Enterprise.


**Supporting Growth Through Shared Infrastructure and Solutions**
As Royal Cable expands its network and customer base, balancing investments in new infrastructure with operating efficiency remains an important business consideration.


Through its partnership with PLDT, Royal Cable has been able to expand services into areas where it has no existing network infrastructure by leveraging PLDT’s nationwide facilities and connectivity footprint. This enabled Royal Cable to avoid significant CAPEX investments in building new facilities while reducing operational costs and accelerating market expansion. In return, PLDT benefits from increased business opportunities and stronger market penetration through Royal Cable’s growing customer base.


These initiatives provide a foundation for further growth as Royal Cable continues expanding its services to residential customers, businesses, and other organizations. With the foundation secured, the path was opened to key expansion projects, including a recent government agency deployment, a retail chain rollout, and a recent expansion into the Bicol Region and selected areas in Mindanao,. By leveraging PLDT’s network framework and connectivity solutions, Royal Cable has successfully met customer requirements, expanded its service reach, and strengthened its position in new markets while delivering reliable services to enterprise and public sector clients.


"As we continue to grow, having the right partners is essential to meeting the changing needs of our customers. Our relationship with PLDT has given us access to connectivity and infrastructure solutions that support our expansion plans. We look forward to building on this partnership as we find more ways to reach customers, improve our services, and create value for the communities we serve," said Dennis Lazaro, President of Royal Cable.


**A Continued Commitment to Customer-Focused Connectivity**
Looking ahead, PLDT Enterprise and Royal Cable see further opportunities to build on their existing collaboration as demand for reliable connectivity continues to grow among residential users, businesses, and local government units.


PLDT and Royal Cable will continue to strengthen their partnership by focusing on growing the subscriber base, particularly within the enterprise segment. This collaboration is expected to drive improved service delivery, higher customer satisfaction, and broader market reach as both companies pursue sustainable business growth.


For PLDT Enterprise, the continuing relationship underscores its commitment to supporting customers beyond their immediate connectivity requirements; helping businesses access solutions that can evolve alongside their operations and long-term ambitions. As Royal Cable continues pursuing growth opportunities, both companies aim to strengthen their collaboration and support the delivery of accessible, reliable, and customer-focused digital services to more communities across the country.


**About PLDT Enterprise**
PLDT Enterprise is the corporate business arm of PLDT, the leading telecommunications and digital services provider in the Philippines. Dedicated to delivering innovative fixed-line, wireless, and ICT solutions, PLDT Enterprise enables businesses to adapt to evolving technological needs, optimize efficiency, continuity, and connectivity, and enhance customer experience. With a strong commitment to doing business responsibly, PLDT Enterprise aims to contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals by enabling digital transformation, championing meaningful innovations, and bridging the digital divide. For more information, visit pldtenterprise.com.
